suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require narcolepsy diagnosis preceding first-onset depressive disorder; separately establish depression and consider sleep disruption, medication effects, psychosocial burden, and other psychiatric disease. Longitudinal register evidence supports temporal risk only; no direct-secondary/aggravation pathwayIntelligence. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Narcolepsy and Major Depressive Disorder
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
